acceptanceCriteria: Core commands, JSON profiles, errors, admission, freshness, omissions and abstention have frozen compatibility contracts.
N-1 readers and deterministic migrations cover every state or profile changed on the path to 1.0.
Experimental verbs are removed from default help or retain a named owner and maturity label.
body: Freeze the Core compatibility boundary for init, adopt, query, context, impact, affected and prove. Do not freeze companion or research profiles by accident.
title: Freeze Core command, wire and migration contracts
